summary: Created an LVM volume group (datavg) and logical volume (datalv) on node1 backed by a file-backed loop device (since the node's single disk had no free space/spare disk), formatted it XFS, mounted at /srv/data, then grew it online from 1000M to <2.15GiB (>2GB) via pvresize + lvextend -r while it stayed mounted, preserving contents (verified by checksum before/after). Made the setup persistent across reboot with a systemd oneshot service that reattaches the loop device and activates the VG before local-fs mounting, referenced from /etc/fstab via x-systemd.requires. Completed the mandatory single-node restart: captured boot_id baseline, rebooted node1, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the LV, mount, and file checksums all recovered correctly post-reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 disk layout (single 20G disk, no free space/no spare block device)
Created 1200M sparse file /var/lib/lvm-backing/disk1.img and attached as /dev/loop0
pvcreate/vgcreate/lvcreate: datavg VG and datalv LV (1000M), mkfs.xfs
Wrote marker.txt and 50MB payload.bin with recorded sha256 checksums
Grew backing file to 2400M, losetup -c to refresh loop size, pvresize /dev/loop0
Created /usr/local/sbin/setup-datavg-loop.sh and systemd unit setup-datavg-loop.service (enabled, ordered before lvm2-activation/local-fs-pre)
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, lvs, df, checksums
Issued systemctl reboot on node1, polled until reachable
Verified new boot_id, service active, LV size, mount, and checksums all match post-reboot

evidence.summary: mount /dev/datavg/datalv /srv/data succeeded; df shows 936M mounted at /srv/data

evidence.requirement: Grow LV to >=2GB while mounted, contents intact
evidence.summary: Wrote marker.txt/payload.bin with checksums, resized backing file+PV, then lvextend -r grew LV to <2.15GiB (>2GB) with fs still mounted; post-grow sha256sum -c confirms both files OK
Captured boot_id 96974ac3..., LV size <2.15g, mount, and verified checksums OK prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement and node unreachable during reboot
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued in background (ack returned before disconnect); subsequent polls show connection timeout/reset confirming the node went down
Post-reboot boot_id is d1a4a2fc..., different from pre-reboot 96974ac3..., proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of LV, mount, and data
evidence.summary: After reboot: setup-datavg-loop.service active, loop0 reattached, LV still <2.15g, /srv/data mounted via datavg-datalv, and sha256sum -c confirms marker.txt and payload.bin unchanged
